Timeline/1958
1958Journal article

Neural learning

Learning with the perceptron

A trainable model connected adaptive weights with pattern recognition.

Frank Rosenblatt

The contribution

Rosenblatt described a probabilistic model of perception and learning. The perceptron became an influential example of a system that could adjust its behavior from examples, giving neural learning a concrete mathematical and experimental direction.

What this does not establish

The capabilities of a single-layer perceptron are limited. This entry does not treat it as equivalent to a modern multilayer network.

Why this date?

1958 dates this journal paper. Earlier perceptron reports exist, so this is not an invention-date claim.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
